headline: Red Sox look to keep momentum rolling without injured Ranger Suarez
morning_brew: It is a big week for the Sox as they head to Chicago, but the mood is definitely tempered by the news on Ranger Suarez. Losing your All-Star starter to left adductor tightness is a real gut punch, especially when the pitching staff has been fighting to keep us competitive. The way the bullpen picked him up in that win over the Angels was a masterclass in grit, but you cannot bank on that kind of heavy lifting every single night for the next stretch.

Management is gonna have to shuffle the deck while Suarez mends, and honestly, the timing could not be worse with the trade deadline chatter getting louder by the hour. My neighbor Rick is already panicking about our depth chart, but I told him to hold his horses until we see who gets the ball in Chicago. We are sitting at 40-48 and fighting for every inch in the standings, so this series is effectively a gut check for the entire rotation.

Elsewhere in the Hub, Brad Stevens is still taking heat for the Jaylen Brown trade, and I honestly don't blame the fans for being restless. You move a guy who helped secure Banner 18, and you are gonna hear about it until the new assets prove they can actually put us back in the hunt. It is a long, quiet summer for the C's, and until the draft picks turn into something tangible, the jury is gonna stay out on this one.
